Monologue: Are you a weasel, its little fangs sunk into the skull of an eagle, never to let go? Or are you a beetle underneath her heel, shiny and squashed?
You live in the ruins of Verehn. A culinary goliath on a tarnished stage. Your taste is just as sharp and lethal as any bayonet.
You have lived your life in fear and compliance. Following the rules and recipes to the very last drop of ink. Clever little lamb.
Choose to serve her, and go play your part as usual. Or, give her a taste of twisting fate as sweet as sugar.
Poison, for a little girl who still writhes inside her, starving, clutching her guts for anything to eat. Rot is kinder than starvation.
Goodbye. May we meet again someday—some other life, when the sun comes back from the clouds.
